rules.statement: Evidence of an oral agreement to lease premises as a rice store cannot be admitted under the Evidence Ordinance if the written lease is formal and does not indicate the purpose for which the premises were to be used.
rules.supporting_quote: "The deed, both in the body of it and in the schedule, describes the premises as 'all those houses and grounds bearing assessment Nos. 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, and 18. situated at Bankshall street, &c., ' and there is no provision or expression in the instrument indicating the purpose for which the premises were to be used."
